entries.english:
Coats of arms of related noble families.

Term: (1593), undated [c. 1600–1791].

Contents: undated ink sketches of coats of arms [c. 1600], 3 leaves; coat of arms of the Eichler family, watercolor pen drawing, 1723, 16 × 20 cm, with accompanying letter; engravings on one sheet of von Reitzenstein, Riedesel zu Eisenbach, von Rosenbach, and Rüdt von Collenberg, 1786; engraving of Berthold Schilling, folio, undated, 2 copies; “Genealogies and descriptions of coats of arms for the Tyroff armorial,” vol. 1, issue 1, Nuremberg 1791, pp. 1–24, unbound.

Extent: 9 documents.
